newsitem.title: USA: Litton gets $72.4 million Navy contract.
newsitem.headline: Litton gets $72.4 million Navy contract.

text.p: Litton Industries Inc. Thursday said the Navy awarded the company $72.4 million for the second year of a five-year contract to continue technical and engineering services.

The contract requires Litton's Ingalls Shipbuilding division in Pascagoula, Miss., to support the Navy's fleet of Ticonderoga class Aegis guided missile cruisers and Spruance and Kidd class destroyers.
Litton provides advanced electronic, information and defence systems, and is a major designer and builder of warships for the Navy and allied nations.
Woodland Hills, Calif.-based Litton's stock rose 75 cents to $48.625 on the New York Stock Exchange at mid-afternoon.
